nom: Thank You Farmer Rice Pure Essential Toner

avis.texte: Gave me an allergic reaction. I put this toner on before bed and woke up next morning with swollen, red, itchy, burning eyelids and neck. Could be the preservative, not sure. If you get this, definitely patch test this before you use all over your face. I should have put a dot with a Qtip and see how my skin reacts after 24 hours.

I have tried a few milky toners at this point, and bought Thank You Farmers after an extensive deep dive into korean milky toner options that were out there. This is by far my favorite that ive tried, and I have even repurchased it (which is somewhat rare for me). It is the thickest one I've tried and very moisturizing. Its a great extra boost in the drier months. Im glad its available to order at Ulta now.
